source_rows.role: December 2024 option and vintage fiscal envelope
source_rows.finding: The $959 billion outlay envelope is not based on a particular force alternative and predates the enacted FY2026 baseline.
The 2021 strategy is illustrative, preserves reserve units, and is not a current executable war plan or FYDP allocation.

source_rows.role: enacted FY2026 authorization and personnel baseline
source_rows.finding: The FY2026 NDAA enacted service end strengths and program authorizations rather than the selected proportional reduction.
The consolidated appropriations law supplies account and program budget authority that the candidate has not mapped to units, programs, or transitions.

source_rows.role: April 2026 current plan and cost dependency analysis
source_rows.finding: CBO reports a $961 billion request, $156 billion reconciliation funding, no 2026 FYDP, and substantial uncertainty about enduring program costs.

gate_rows.evidence: CBO fixes the option envelope and an illustrative strategy while explicitly separating the outlay estimate from any particular alternative.
Public Laws 119-60 and 119-75 establish the FY2026 authorization, end-strength, and appropriation perimeter.
No current FYDP or candidate-authored unit and program allocation maps the proportional reduction into the enacted baseline.
No current war-plan, mobilization, response-time, or simultaneous-conflict stress result is published for the candidate.
No separation, civilian, contractor, family, installation, or regional transition plan and cost is attached to the candidate.
Enacted program changes and reconciliation funding are not reconciled to candidate quantities, milestones, suppliers, cancellations, or sunk costs.
No current-baseline score reconciles the December 2024 envelope with enacted FY2026 laws, 2025 reconciliation funds, or the missing 2026 FYDP.

reopen_triggers: a complete proportional-force policy package maps units, programs, transitions, allies, and readiness
DoD or CBO publishes a matching FYDP allocation and stress analysis
CBO publishes a current-law score for the specified force package
current law materially changes the enacted force or program perimeter
